passive.name: Demon Shade
passive.description: When out of combat, Evelynn enters Demon Shade. Demon Shade heals Evelynn when she is low on health and grants Camouflage after level 6.

spells.name: Hate Spike
spells.description: Evelynn strikes with her Lasher, dealing magic damage to the first enemy hit and causing Evelynn's next 3 Attacks or Abilities on that unit to deal an additional magic damage. Evelynn can Recast this Ability up to times. Recast: Evelynn fires spikes through the nearest enemy, dealing magic damage to all enemies hit.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation MissileDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Allure
spells.description: Evelynn marks a champion or monster for 5 seconds. If Evelynn hits the target with an Attack or Ability, she will expunge the mark, refund its cost, and Slow the target by % for seconds. If the mark lasts at least 2.5 seconds, expunging it has extra effects:Against champions: Charms them for second(s) and removes % Magic Resist for seconds.Against monsters: Charms them for seconds and deals magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation MonsterDamageTotalTOOLTIP was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Whiplash
spells.description: Evelynn whips an enemy, dealing plus max Health magic damage. Evelynn gains % Move Speed for seconds. Entering Demon Shade refreshes this Ability's cooldown and empowers it. When this Ability is empowered, Evelynn dashes to the target and deals plus max Health magic damage to her target and everyone she passes through instead.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation PercentHealthBaseTOOLTIP was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Last Caress
spells.description: Evelynn unleashes her demonic energy, dealing heavy damage, becoming Untargetable and teleporting backwards. She deals magic damage, increased to against enemies below 30% Health. Upon cast, set Demon Shade to a 1.25 second cooldown.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation Damage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
